title: clickcast CI-stable assertion set
description: Deterministic distillation of a clickcast sidecar (`reel.gif.json`) into the subset that stays byte-identical across runs of the same scenario against the same URL. Emitted by `clickcast assertions --json` and by `Reel.assertions()`. Intended as the committed baseline for a 2-line CI regression gate — diff current-vs-baseline, non-zero exit on drift. Explicitly excludes timestamps, wall-clock durations, frame filenames, resolved URLs, and cursor coordinates because they change every run even when the UI under test is unchanged.

schema_version.description: Bumps on breaking changes to the distilled shape.

step_count.description: Number of executed steps (mirrors the length of `steps`).

steps.description: One entry per executed step, in scenario order.

label.description: Human label passed to the builder (or null when unset).

console_error_count.description: Count of `console.error` messages captured during this step. The raw messages are excluded on purpose — text changes across runs (timestamps, stack traces), counts do not.

page_error_count.description: Count of uncaught page errors captured during this step.

network_failed_count.description: Count of failed network requests captured during this step.

skip_reason.description: Enumerated skip reason (see StepReport.skip_reason) — CI baselines can pin the KIND of skip, not just the status verb. Null on non-skipped steps. Added in #151 (AI-2).

error_code.description: Enumerated error kind (see StepReport.error_code) — CI baselines can gate on error KIND, not drifting error MESSAGES. Null on successful steps. Added in #151 (AI-5).
